collection.title: Mercedes-Benz V Class 2014 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz V Class Van 2014 Onwards (447) requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this V Class which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
